findings.claim: The class-wide ordering repair still omits the input order for B1a latest-job selection. Distinct positive job IDs can share (name, run_attempt), so U2 passes. The pinned tieu_dung retains the first record at a tied maximum attempt. With a success record and a failure duplicate, reversing the REST job list changes vi_pham from C4 to C2+C4 and therefore the required K6 reason. B3 preserves page/item order, passes those jobs to the pinned consumer, and simultaneously requires the same complete reasons for every API order. The rejection decision remains khong_dat, but the frozen diagnostic/acceptance contract is not deterministic. This affects every job role, not only the collector. A4 and push run timestamp ties from SPEC-16 themselves are repaired.

evidence.observed_output: U2 unique_positive_ids=true in both directions; forward violations=[C4], K6_reason=luat_C:C4; reverse violations=[C2,C4], K6_reason=luat_C:C2+C4. All 11 job-role variants reproduce it. Existing 118 semantic fixtures have 0 order-sensitive cases; numeric-ID sorting changes 0/118 fixture outcomes.

Pinned consumer replaces moi[name] only for a strictly greater run_attempt; C4 rejects duplicate name/attempt pairs, but C2 and further checks still use the selected record. B3 K6 records all violated rule names; class J preserves API page/item order.

suggested_fix.where: B3 §4.0 and §4.2 K1-to-K6 adapter boundary, plus acceptance 4/19 and mutants 11. This is where B3 owns independently collected REST ordering; the pinned B1a contract must remain unchanged.
suggested_fix.how: Freeze a deterministic ordering of the complete, U2-valid jobs input before invoking the unchanged B1a consumer, for example ascending numeric ID. Continue to pass every record so C4 still rejects duplicate (name, attempt) pairs; do not deduplicate or change C1–C12. The executed probe script provides a reusable counterexample. Sorting was checked against all 118 current semantic fixtures with zero changed outcomes, but is a proposed adapter policy, not an implemented fix.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Add a case-owned test for same-name/same-attempt jobs with different IDs and opposite conclusions, both orders and across pages, covering collector, aggregate and shard roles. Assert identical complete violations, K6 reason, final state and zero pushes. A mutant removing the adapter ordering must die with that case’s own exception; retain the full 120/118 fixture contract.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: Sorting must not become deduplication, weaken C4, or select an older attempt. Define the direction explicitly so two implementations do not choose opposite tied records. Keep the approved B1a function/fixtures/schema hashes intact.

findings.claim: Acceptance 11 again mandates killing a semantically equivalent aggregation mutant: counting khong_danh_gia as dat. Under §4.5 AND, dat is the identity. Replacing skipped children with dat only inside the fold, while retaining their recorded khong_danh_gia states and the reason filter, cannot change the result, reason or push count. Thus an n/n genuine-kill requirement is not achievable for that literal mutant. Changing the recorded status to dat is a different, observable mutant, but the spec does not distinguish the two. This is the same equivalent-mutant acceptance mechanism as SPEC-12; the old early-read mode mutant stays correctly excluded.

evidence.observed_output: Exhaustive vectors of length 1–8 over dat/khong_dat/khong_do_duoc/khong_danh_gia: 87,380 vectors; 0 output differences between excluding skipped values and replacing them with dat in the fold. Recorded states remain unchanged.

The fold excludes khong_danh_gia; reason selection excludes it separately; acceptance 11 requires a dedicated mutant “phép con khong_danh_gia bị tính là dat” and n/n real kills. The same paragraph explicitly excludes the older equivalent mode-read mutant.

suggested_fix.where: Acceptance 11, beside the two khong_danh_gia mutants, and the exact-state assertions in acceptance 4. Repair the test contract rather than introducing artificial product behavior to kill an identity transformation.
suggested_fix.how: Explicitly exclude the fold-only identity mutant as equivalent, as already done for early mode reading. If the intended defect is false reporting, define the required mutant as replacing an emitted child state khong_danh_gia with dat. Keep the khong_dat fold mutant, which is distinguishable. suggested_fix.locking_test: Use a K5 transport-failure case with K7 skipped. A case-owned exception must detect changing K7’s recorded status to dat while the overall state remains khong_do_duoc. Mutate the recorded status, not merely the fold input; unrelated exceptions must still count as false credit.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: Do not remove the skipped-state assertions, count equivalent mutants as killed, or turn skipped work into a success claim. Updating the required mutant inventory must preserve the intended reporting property.
